title: Her rooms on the orlop deck: R3, a sourced table of facts
written: 2026-11-20, by the R3 session (Claude Opus 5.5), under docs/research/RESEARCH_rooms_plans_licence_v1_1_2026-11-20.md, on the coordinator's word after F and G
rules: Facts only: which room, where, how big, which door to which. No image or drawing of any plan is kept. Every row cites the reference read and the original checked, or says it was not checked. Bets are tagged as bets.
reference: ET: Encyclopedia Titanica's free deck plans, Orlop Deck (https://www.encyclopedia-titanica.org/titanic-deckplans/orlop-deck.html; drawn by Bruce Beveridge for Titanic The Ship Magnificent, The History Press 2008), read on the page in the built-in browser on 2026-11-20, nothing saved
original: Shipbuilder 1911: The Shipbuilder, Midsummer 1911 (the Olympic and Titanic number), plate 5, 'Orlop Deck' and 'Lower Orlop Deck', as reproduced by GG Archives (https://www.ggarchives.com/OT/Titanic/25-ImageLibrary/TheShipbuilder-10-Design-SpecialPlates.html); too small to read room by room, not opened this time.
how: Read at block level, coarser than E, F and G: views at zoom 0.5 with the browser pane hidden (screenshots at changing scales), so walls are placed by the frame labels printed beside them, to about two or three frames, and offsets by eye, to a few feet. Every row is tagged 'approx'.
Frames to feet: her frames are the same on every deck, so this table takes E deck's anchors (data/rooms/E_deck.json), with this deck's own ends at about 148A and 156F [approx].

The orlop is a deck only in the holds forward of D and abaft M. Between them it is no floor: the boiler rooms and the engine rooms rise through it. Those rows are kind 'machinery' or 'bunker', one a room or a cross bunker, across her breadth, so that the slabs below G deck are covered [read; the outlines from the reference, the contents not].

The model has no slab of its own for the orlop: R1 cuts the space below G deck as one slab ('below G'), and these rows stand in it. Her side in metres is the model's half-breadth halfway between the orlop and G deck.
Doors: 2 ft 3 in by default [bet]. Watertight doors: the reference marks one W.T.D. on this deck, in N.
Derived fields (x_m, y_m, poly_m, area_m2, zone, slab, plan_compartment) are written by: node tools/rooms_table.js --write data/rooms/orlop_deck.json

frames.note: E deck's anchors (her frames, feet forward of amidships), with the orlop's own ends.

bulkheads.note: Watertight bulkheads where the reference marks them on the orlop (W.T.B. labels, written "A" to "P"). B stands at 114F here, where E deck has it at 110F and F and G at 111F: the model's B (the Inquiry's 91 ft) is the orlop's.
